_comment: USD per million tokens, keyed by the telemetry/transcript 'model' field. Each entry carries an 'input' and an 'output' rate. 'default' is used for unknown models. The eval scorecard's prompt_chars estimate uses 'input' only (tokens ~ prompt_chars / 4). session_cost.py additionally prices cache-read tokens at input * _cache_multipliers.cache_read and cache-creation tokens at input * _cache_multipliers.cache_creation. Sonnet 5 intro input price was 2.0 through 2026-08-31 (then 3.0).
